node.statement: Dependency-closed compressed-unit comparison, independent of node 1.2. Let S be T_n or R_n and put u_S=Co_{S,S}(S). Validated node 1.1 gives ||S||<=M, ||S^2-S||<=delta, e<=e_0<=1, and ||Co_{S,S}-L_S R_S||<=k*e. Since (L_S R_S)(S)=S(S^2), the operator-norm estimate and the epsilon-banach-cstar multiplication bound give ||u_S-S||<=k*e*||S||+||S(S^2)-S||. By bilinearity, S(S^2)-S=S(S^2-S)+(S^2-S), so ||S(S^2)-S||<=(1+epsilon)||S||*||S^2-S||+||S^2-S||<=(2*M+1)*e. Hence, with the universal K_u_local=k*M+2*M+1, both ||u_{T,n}-T_n||<=K_u_local*e and ||u_{R,n}-R_n||<=K_u_local*e follow using only validated node 1.1 and the registered axioms.
